about:
# Comment Attempts

Lets you comment your <cy>attempt count</c>, just like you can with your <cg>percentage</c>.  
Just tick the box <cb>underneath</c> the % toggle, and you're <cp>good to go</c>!

## Bugs
Report bugs on [github](https://github.com/DominoKiddoo/commentattempts-gdmod), or through discord (dm <c-00ff4c>@D</c><c-19ff5e>o</c><c-32ff6f>m</c><c-4bff81>i</c><c-64ff93>n</c><c-7dffa6>o</c><c-97ffba>K</c><c-b0ffcd>i</c><c-9effb1>d</c><c-77ff7f>d</c><c-50ff4c>o</c><c-29ff1a>o</c>) 


  


a lil fun fact is that the number in this mods icon is doggies attempt count on grief, so thats pretty cool :3
